blocks.prompt: 9 By computing the area of triangle \(ABC\) check whether the points are collinear where \(A(0, 4)\), \(B(3, 2)\) and \(C(6, 0)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh collinearity (ek line par hona) check karne ka sawal hai, aur tareeqa sawal ne khud bata diya: area se.
5.7 ka Corollary kehta hai ke teen points collinear tabhi hain jab un se bane 'triangle' ka area zero ho.
To hum area formula lagayenge aur dekhenge ke jawab zero aata hai ya nahi.
Plan: values rakhna, simplify, natija.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(0, 4)\), \(B(3, 2)\), \(C(6, 0)\).
Maloom karna: kya \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) collinear hain?
Tareeqa: \(\Delta = \frac{1}{2}[x_1(y_2 - y_3) + x_2(y_3 - y_1) + x_3(y_1 - y_2)]\); \(\Delta = 0\) ka matlab collinear.

Natija
\(\Delta = 0\), is liye points collinear hain.
Kyun: teen points koi jagah tabhi nahi gherte jab woh ek hi line par hon.

Tasdeeq:
\[m_{AB} = \dfrac{2 - 4}{3 - 0} = -\dfrac{2}{3}\]
\[m_{BC} = \dfrac{0 - 2}{6 - 3} = -\dfrac{2}{3}\]
Dono slopes barabar aur \(B\) common point, is liye teeno ek line par \(\checkmark\). (Yeh line \(2x + 3y = 12\) hai.)
Do alag tareeqon (area aur slopes) ne ek hi baat kahi, is liye natija pakka hai.
